sources.summary: Be Part of the most influential architectural gathering ever held in Aotearoa New Zealand. Te Kāhui Whaihanga New Zealand Institute of Architects (NZIA), in partnership with the Commonwealth Association of Architects (CAA), proudly announces the convergence of two events in 2026: the biennial NZIA in:situ Conference and the CAA General Assembly. Together, these landmark events will form the most significant gathering of architectural professionals, thought leaders, and industry partners ever held in Aotearoa New Zealand.
